title: exergy operation
description: PHYSICAL (thermo-mechanical) flow exergy of a mixture state against a DECLARED dead state: b = (h − h0) − T0·(s − s0), every term the engine's own H_real/S_real at the same composition, both legs published so the total re-adds. The dead state is the problem's declaration — a missing `deadState {}` REFUSES (an exergy is a statement about a state AND an environment, and the engine does not choose the plant's environment). CHEMICAL exergy refuses by name: it needs a standard-environment model (Szargut) nobody has curated.

state.title: Thermodynamic state
state.description: The (T, P, composition) whose physical exergy is evaluated.

deadState.title: Dead state (the environment)
deadState.description: REQUIRED. The environment the exergy is measured against — declared by the case, never defaulted by the engine.
